# Why does DeepMimic learn skills from examples, and does that establish hardware readiness?

> **Current answer:** DeepMimic combines a phase-conditioned state, imitation and task rewards, Reference State Initialization (RSI), and Early Termination (ET) to learn several simulated skills. These mechanisms show that examples can shape policy search effectively; they do not prove that the same motion can be deployed directly on a physical humanoid.

## Controllers and methods

- PPO policy combining imitation and task objectives with PD targets.

## Result

- DeepMimic combines a phase-conditioned state, imitation and task rewards, Reference State Initialization (RSI), and Early Termination (ET) to learn several simulated skills. These mechanisms show that examples can shape policy search effectively; they do not prove that the same motion can be deployed directly on a physical humanoid.

## Limitations

- The reference motion has been matched to the character morphology and has a reliable phase definition.
- Dynamics, contact, and actuator boundaries are validated separately for the deployment platform.
